verdict.rationale: Otter supports background automation scoped to meetings: scheduled auto-join notetakers, automatic transcription/summarization, auto-extraction of action items, and automatic syncing of notes/action items to CRMs, Jira, Asana, Zendesk, Airtable, S3, etc. (otter-docs-17,9,10,28,29,31,4,3,26,40). This is real autonomous background behavior but it is templated around meeting workflows rather than a general-purpose automation/agent builder where a user defines arbitrary triggers/conditions. Missing for 10: evidence of a flexible, user-configurable automation/workflow engine (beyond Zapier/webhooks) and independent confirmation that these automations reliably run unattended without manual re-triggering.
